scope: literal source heads, public homogeneous trees and lazy derivative channels
limitations: No dense deformation prefix or full pair matrix is constructed. Original residuals and selected row derivatives are charged, and residual inputs still have B^(3/2) scale. Literal full-source comparisons are validation only. Fixed-base kernels and the total every-run bit-operation proof remain open.

lean_validation.scope: Focused module build, ordinary root import, all namespace declarations/helpers, source scan and exact diagnostic replay. No publication or wider gates.
lean_validation.unverified_implementation: GMP polynomial/remainder evaluation, marked tree implementation, lazy derivative scheduling and the total every-run bit-operation cost. Lean certifies literal source heads, classified homogeneous extraction, checked-unit index semantics and a tree slot model.
lean_validation.formal_control_scope: Original interval rows over ZMod 35 plus exact coefficient-slot budgets. These are source/decoder and representation controls, not an every-semiprime factorization complexity theorem.
lean_validation.prototype_counter_scope: Head-tree coefficient slots sum lengths across all levels including leaves and carried nodes. They are cumulative representation counts, not machine allocation or bit-operation counts. Timings include independent public setup, residual source, requested derivative channels and index recovery.
